ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white pixels to dominant low-intensity dark gray/black pixels, characterized by scattered stippling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface with a high-frequency distribution of small, contiguous white pixel clusters (mottling) throughout both lobes, becoming more densely packed near the trailing edge and median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 140 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations with deep notches located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; the left lobe displays a lower frequency of serrations with moderate pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity extending from the median notch transitioning into convexity toward the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters, approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter, concentrated on the mid-section of the left lobe and scattered across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical, parallel high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) detected on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge contour.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe adjacent to the median notch; heavy scarring and possible blunt-force truncation at the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast vertical striping pattern on the extreme right lobe tip, localized to the terminal edge.
